datasets.name: ON-Harmony
datasets.full_name: Oxford-Nottingham Harmonisation resource
datasets.sessions: 165 multimodal sessions; 9 participants with 6 within-scanner repeats (OpenNeuro ds004712, CC0)
datasets.description: Travelling-heads resource: T1w, T2w, dMRI, resting-state fMRI and SWI per session with protocols aligned to UK Biobank, built to separate biological, between-scanner and within-scanner variability.
datasets.paper_title: A multi-site, multi-modal travelling-heads resource for brain MRI harmonisation

extra_papers.title: A resource for development and comparison of multimodal brain 3 T MRI harmonisation approaches

datasets.name: SRPBS Traveling Subject
datasets.full_name: SRPBS Traveling Subject MRI Dataset (DecNef project, Japan)
datasets.description: Traveling subjects scanned at the sites of the SRPBS multi-disorder database; used to separate measurement bias from sampling bias in resting-state connectivity.
datasets.paper_title: A multi-site, multi-disorder resting-state magnetic resonance image database

extra_papers.title: Harmonization of resting-state functional MRI data across multiple imaging sites via the separation of site differences into sampling bias and measurement bias

datasets.name: Brain/MINDS Beyond traveling subjects
datasets.full_name: Brain/MINDS Beyond Human Brain MRI project — traveling-subject data
datasets.description: Public traveling-subject data from the Japanese Brain/MINDS Beyond project, used to quantify cross-scanner differences in diffusion-MRI structural networks.
datasets.paper_title: Cross-scanner reproducibility and harmonization of a diffusion MRI structural brain network: A traveling subject study of multi-b acquisition

datasets.name: MASiVar
datasets.full_name: Multisite, multiscanner, and multisubject acquisitions for studying variability in diffusion weighted MRI
datasets.participants: 14 healthy adults + 83 children (5–8 y); Cohort II: 5 adults each on 3–4 scanners
datasets.sessions: 319 diffusion scans, b = 1000–3000 s/mm² (OpenNeuro ds003416, CC0)
datasets.description: Publicly available, preprocessed diffusion data designed to quantify intrasession, intersession, interscanner and intersubject variability.
datasets.paper_title: MASiVar: Multisite, multiscanner, and multisubject acquisitions for studying variability in diffusion weighted MRI

datasets.name: Multi-shell dMRI traveling adults (Tong et al.)
datasets.full_name: Multicenter dataset of multi-shell diffusion MRI in healthy traveling adults with identical settings
datasets.description: Multi-shell diffusion data acquired with identical settings across centres, for testing the reproducibility of multi-shell diffusion models and harmonization.
datasets.paper_title: Multicenter dataset of multi-shell diffusion MRI in healthy traveling adults with identical settings

datasets.name: SIMON
datasets.full_name: Single Individual volunteer for Multiple Observations across Networks
datasets.sites: 36 scanners (13 models, 3 manufacturers), 73 sessions over 15+ years
datasets.sessions: 599+ multi-contrast images
datasets.description: One person scanned repeatedly on dozens of scanners: T1w, T2w, PD, FLAIR, T2*, diffusion, SWI, ASL and resting-state fMRI. Useful for scanner-effect and longitudinal-stability tests.
datasets.paper_title: Structural and functional multi-platform MRI series of a single human volunteer over more than fifteen years

datasets.name: MUSHAC / CDMRI benchmark
datasets.full_name: Cross-scanner and cross-protocol diffusion MRI harmonisation benchmark (CDMRI 2017–2018 challenges)
datasets.sessions: "standard" and "state-of-the-art" protocols per scanner
datasets.description: The reference benchmark for diffusion-signal harmonization, with an evaluation of submitted algorithms.
datasets.paper_title: Cross-scanner and cross-protocol diffusion MRI data harmonisation: A benchmark database and evaluation of algorithms

datasets.name: QuantConn challenge
datasets.full_name: MICCAI-CDMRI 2023 QuantConn challenge
datasets.participants: Same individuals, two acquisitions (10× more subjects than MUSHAC)
datasets.description: Harmonization challenge evaluated on bundles, tractography and connectomes rather than only voxel-wise measures.
datasets.paper_title: MICCAI-CDMRI 2023 QuantConn Challenge Findings on Achieving Robust Quantitative Connectivity through Harmonized Preprocessing of Diffusion MRI

datasets.name: OpenBHB
datasets.full_name: Open Big Healthy Brains
datasets.description: Uniformly preprocessed T1w data (VBM, quasi-raw, FreeSurfer) built as a brain-age benchmark with explicit site debiasing.
datasets.paper_title: OpenBHB: a Large-Scale Multi-Site Brain MRI Data-set for Age Prediction and Debiasing

datasets.name: Credence Cartridge Radiomics phantom
datasets.full_name: Credence Cartridge Radiomics (CCR) phantom CT scans
datasets.participants: Phantom with 10 material cartridges (+ 20 NSCLC patients for comparison)
datasets.description: Standard phantom for measuring CT scanner variability of radiomic features.
datasets.paper_title: Measuring Computed Tomography Scanner Variability of Radiomics Features

datasets.name: Multi-centric anthropomorphic CT phantom
datasets.full_name: Multi-centric anthropomorphic 3D CT phantom benchmark for harmonization
datasets.sessions: 1,378 image series, several doses
datasets.description: Benchmark for CT image- and feature-level harmonization acquired with a harmonized protocol.
datasets.paper_title: A Multi-Centric Anthropomorphic 3D CT Phantom-Based Benchmark Dataset for Harmonization

datasets.name: ABCD
datasets.full_name: Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study
datasets.participants: >10,000 children recruited at 9–10 y, followed through adolescence
datasets.sessions: Longitudinal
datasets.description: The largest pediatric multisite cohort; acquisition was harmonized prospectively, yet scanner effects remain and are a common harmonization test-bed.
datasets.paper_title: The Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study: Imaging acquisition across 21 sites

datasets.name: ADNI
datasets.full_name: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
datasets.participants: Older adults: cognitively normal, MCI and AD
datasets.sessions: Longitudinal; MRI, FDG/amyloid PET, fluid biomarkers
datasets.description: The reference multisite dementia cohort, with a standardized MRI protocol and phantom-based QC; used by most structural harmonization papers.
datasets.paper_title: The Alzheimer's disease neuroimaging initiative (ADNI): MRI methods

datasets.name: UK Biobank imaging
datasets.full_name: UK Biobank brain imaging
datasets.sites: Several imaging centres with identical scanners and protocol
datasets.sessions: Repeat imaging for a subset
datasets.description: Population cohort with a single harmonized protocol; small residual site effects make it a useful near-best case.
datasets.paper_title: Multimodal population brain imaging in the UK Biobank prospective epidemiological study

datasets.name: IXI
datasets.full_name: Information eXtraction from Images dataset
datasets.description: Small, fully open dataset (T1, T2, PD, MRA, DTI); a common quick test for image-level harmonization because the three sites differ in vendor and field strength.

datasets.name: ABIDE I + II
datasets.full_name: Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange
datasets.participants: 2,156 cross-sectional datasets (ABIDE I 1,112; ABIDE II 1,044 incl. 284 dMRI)
datasets.sites: ABIDE II: 16 international institutions (plus ABIDE I sites)
datasets.description: Retrospectively aggregated autism and control data with strong site effects; the standard benchmark for multi-site classification and domain adaptation.
datasets.paper_title: Enhancing studies of the connectome in autism using the autism brain imaging data exchange II

extra_papers.title: The autism brain imaging data exchange: towards a large-scale evaluation of the intrinsic brain architecture in autism

datasets.name: ADHD-200
datasets.full_name: ADHD-200 Consortium sample
datasets.participants: Children and adolescents with ADHD and controls
datasets.description: Open resting-state and anatomical data released for a classification competition; frequently used for cross-site generalization.
datasets.paper_title: The ADHD-200 Consortium: a model to advance the translational potential of neuroimaging in clinical neuroscience

datasets.name: CoRR
datasets.full_name: Consortium for Reliability and Reproducibility
datasets.sessions: Test–retest
datasets.description: Test–retest data across sites: lets you compare within-site reliability with between-site differences.
datasets.paper_title: An open science resource for establishing reliability and reproducibility in functional connectomics

datasets.name: SRPBS Multi-disorder
datasets.full_name: SRPBS multi-site, multi-disorder resting-state MRI database
datasets.sites: Multiple Japanese sites (see the traveling-subject entry)
datasets.description: Psychiatric multi-disorder cohort released together with its own traveling-subject harmonization data.
datasets.paper_title: A multi-site, multi-disorder resting-state magnetic resonance image database

datasets.name: AIBL
datasets.full_name: Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle study of ageing
datasets.participants: 1,112 older adults (MRI + PiB PET in about a quarter)
datasets.sessions: Longitudinal
datasets.description: Dementia cohort often pooled with ADNI as an external site.
datasets.paper_title: The Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle (AIBL) study of aging: methodology and baseline characteristics of 1112 individuals recruited for a longitudinal study of Alzheimer's disease

datasets.name: PPMI
datasets.full_name: Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative
datasets.participants: People with Parkinson's disease, prodromal and controls
datasets.sessions: Longitudinal
datasets.description: Longitudinal Parkinson's cohort with imaging, biofluid and clinical data.
datasets.paper_title: The Parkinson Progression Marker Initiative (PPMI)

datasets.name: Healthy Brain Network
datasets.full_name: Child Mind Institute Healthy Brain Network
datasets.description: Transdiagnostic pediatric biobank with MRI and EEG collected at several sites — one of the few large resources to test EEG and MRI harmonization together.
datasets.paper_title: An open resource for transdiagnostic research in pediatric mental health and learning disorders

datasets.name: HCP Lifespan (Development & Aging)
datasets.full_name: Human Connectome Project — Lifespan Development and Aging
datasets.sites: Multiple sites on matched Siemens Prisma scanners
datasets.description: HCP-style protocols extended across ages and sites; a near-harmonized acquisition useful as a low-site-effect reference.
datasets.paper_title: Extending the Human Connectome Project across ages: Imaging protocols for the Lifespan Development and Aging projects

datasets.name: LIDC-IDRI
datasets.full_name: Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative
datasets.participants: 1,018 thoracic CT cases with nodule annotations by 4 radiologists
datasets.description: The common multi-institution CT set for radiomics robustness and harmonization tests.
datasets.paper_title: The Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI): a completed reference database of lung nodules on CT scans

datasets.full_name: TREAT-MS pragmatic trial — traveling-subject sub-study (NCT03500328)
datasets.participants: 15 participants (5 healthy controls, people with stable MS)
datasets.sites: 9 sites in total; each subject visited 3–5 sites (eastern US)
datasets.sessions: 126 sessions; scan–rescan T1w, T2w, FLAIR, PD
datasets.description: Clinical-trial traveling subjects: initial and final sessions at Johns Hopkins with 3–5 other sites in between, same protocol. Private; used to validate HACA3+.
datasets.paper_title: Harmonizing MR Images Across 100+ Scanners: Multi-site Validation with Traveling Subjects and Real-world Protocols
datasets.name: TREAT-MS traveling subjects

datasets.full_name: Frequently Traveling Human Phantom
datasets.sites: 116 scanners (later releases: 123 scanners; 96 scanners at 76 sites with back-to-back repeats)
datasets.sessions: T1w only; repeat scans on many scanners
datasets.description: One person scanned on more than a hundred clinical scanners — the widest scanner coverage of any traveling-subject resource, used to test inter-scanner stability of volumetry and harmonization.

extra_papers.title: Automatic segmentation of the thalamus using a massively trained 3D convolutional neural network: higher sensitivity for the detection of reduced thalamus volume by improved inter-scanner stability
Easy-to-use and easy-to-interpret quality control of 3D gradient echo T1-weighted MR acquisition sequences for improved test-retest stability of MRI-based hippocampus volumetry

datasets.name: FTHP (Frequently Traveling Human Phantom)

datasets.full_name: DWI Traveling Human Phantom study (PREDICT-HD reliability)
datasets.sessions: DWI with two protocols, 3D T1w MP-RAGE and T2w SPACE, repeated (OpenNeuro ds000206, CC0)
datasets.description: Early multi-centre diffusion reliability study; still one of the few open traveling-subject sets with DWI plus T1w/T2w.
datasets.paper_title: MultiCenter Reliability of Diffusion Tensor Imaging
datasets.name: DWI Traveling Human Phantom

datasets.full_name: Traveling-subject T1w dataset comparing TS-GLM, ComBat and TS-ComBat
datasets.sessions: Test–retest scans
datasets.description: Used to show that traveling-subject harmonization reduces measurement bias more than ComBat, and that at least 6 traveling subjects are needed.
datasets.paper_title: Comparison of traveling-subject and ComBat harmonization methods for assessing structural brain characteristics
datasets.name: Japanese T1w traveling subjects (Maikusa et al.)

datasets.full_name: TRavelling Across Melbourne for FIXel-based analysis
datasets.sessions: Harmonised multi-shell DWI; preprocessed derivatives on OpenNeuro ds006935 (CC0)
datasets.description: Traveling heads for fixel-based analysis: reproducibility of FD, FC, FDC, FA and MD across scanners.
datasets.paper_title: TRAMFIX: TRavelling Across Melbourne for FIXel-based analysis (a reproducibility study)
datasets.name: TRAMFIX

datasets.full_name: Traveling human phantoms + lifespan cohort across three Canadian MRI centres
datasets.participants: 23 traveling phantoms (138 scans) + 856 healthy participants aged 5–91
datasets.sessions: Each phantom scanned twice at every site; non-harmonized T1w protocols
datasets.description: Compares traveling-phantom correction factors with ComBat on lifespan volume trajectories.
datasets.paper_title: Lifespan Volume Trajectories From Non–harmonized T1–Weighted MRI Do Not Differ After Site Correction Based on Traveling Human Phantoms
datasets.name: Alberta traveling human phantoms (Treit et al.)

datasets.full_name: Movement-related artefacts dataset
datasets.sessions: Matched motion-free and motion-corrupted T1w scans
datasets.description: Not multisite, but the standard set for testing whether harmonization or IQM-based correction handles motion artefacts (used e.g. by ComCat).
datasets.paper_title: Movement-related artefacts (MR-ART) dataset of matched motion-corrupted and clean structural MRI brain scans
datasets.name: MR-ART

datasets.full_name: Brain Tumor Segmentation benchmark (multi-institutional)
datasets.participants: Glioma patients, multi-contrast MRI (T1, T1c, T2, FLAIR); grows with each challenge edition
datasets.description: Multi-institutional tumour MRI widely used to test radiomics robustness and intensity harmonization.
datasets.paper_title: The Multimodal Brain Tumor Image Segmentation Benchmark (BRATS)
datasets.name: BraTS

datasets.full_name: Harmonized multi-dataset EEG benchmark for cross-hardware generalization
datasets.participants: Five public motor-imagery corpora (PhysioNet MI, Cho2017, Lee2019-MI, Shin2017A, Weibo2014)
datasets.sessions: 20 standard channels, 8–32 Hz, 3-s trials; Euclidean-aligned; leave-one-dataset-out splits
datasets.description: A ready-made EEG set for testing harmonization and domain generalization across recording hardware.
datasets.paper_title: A Harmonized Multi-Dataset EEG Benchmark for Cross-Hardware Generalization
datasets.name: Cross-hardware EEG benchmark

datasets.full_name: Mother of All BCI Benchmarks
datasets.participants: 250+ subjects in the original release; the library now wraps dozens of open BCI datasets
datasets.sites: Many labs and recording systems (one per dataset)
datasets.sessions: Motor imagery, P300/ERP and SSVEP paradigms; within-session, cross-session and cross-subject evaluation
datasets.description: Python library (MNE + scikit-learn) that downloads and preprocesses open brain-computer-interface EEG datasets behind one interface and runs standard evaluations. Each dataset comes from a different lab, amplifier and montage, which makes it the usual testbed for cross-dataset EEG alignment and transfer methods.
datasets.paper_title: MOABB: trustworthy algorithm benchmarking for BCIs

extra_papers.title: The largest EEG-based BCI reproducibility study for open science: the MOABB benchmark

datasets.name: MOABB
